title: A held planning reply cannot cross a real role revocation
description: ADR-071 authority proof on an isolated gateway. Warm five real collections, capture a real admin roadmap reply, downgrade the same actor to operator and deliver the unchanged frame on its actual new connection. A later current permitted read establishes stream ordering; forbidden UI/cache/SQLite facts must stay absent. Complete full revocation, recovery and owned-identity cleanup.

proofTargets.claim: Switching accounts through the real UI deletes all five old saved planning collections.
An operator downgrade retains farm access, freshly reads three allowed lists and clears saved roadmap/project facts.

The old admin roadmap request is retired, and its unchanged actual reply delivered on the verified operator connection cannot restore forbidden UI/cache/SQLite facts after a later permitted response is processed.
Revoking the disposable account's admin role clears all five saved and cached planning collections.
Restored authority refetches all five lists through their actual mounted views.
The original identity/profile stay unchanged, the disposable actor is retired, and the owned browser session closes after restoration.

prove.intent: Prove actual role changes and an old planning reply on a new connection.

switch.intent: Normal account switching deletes the previous principal's saved planning rows.

partial-role.intent: Refetch permitted lists and remove forbidden facts after the downgrade.

revoke.intent: A real admin-role revocation clears every saved planning collection.

recover.intent: Restored authority requires new current reads on all five actual views.

cleanup.intent: Restore the original account and retire the disposable identity.

held-reply.intent: Deliver an actual old reply after the real role change without restoring facts.
